authority.query: Verify the exact entity represented by website bellavita.com.tw (title: BELLAVITA). Find only public sources that clearly refer to this exact website or brand. Exclude similarly named but unrelated entities. Return unknown if entity alignment cannot be verified. Cite every retained source. Start with exactly ALIASES: name1 | name2 using only names supported by the official site or corroborating sources; otherwise write ALIASES: UNKNOWN.
authority.answer:
ALIASES: BELLAVITA | 寶麗廣塲

The exact website bellavita.com.tw corresponds to BELLAVITA 寶麗廣塲, a shopping mall in Taipei’s Xinyi District, with the official site listing the name and address at 松仁路28號.[3][6] Public third-party sources that explicitly match this website also identify it as Bellavita Shopping Mall / BELLAVITA in Taipei.[10][13]

Unknown: no additional official corroboration for other aliases beyond the supported names was verified from the available public sources.[3][6][10][13]
